angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 612,912 km at 101.00 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.9006 +/- 0.0138 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 101.00 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.881 +/- 0.038 solar radii from Zhou et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-251 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract): 612,912 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.036 +/- 0.013 solar masses from Zhou et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-251 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5875 +/- 100 K from Zhou et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-251 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zhou et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-251 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-251.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.563, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-37 15287: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-251 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.106 dex, from Zhou et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-251 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.0804, from Zhou et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-251 (pscomppars): age 0.18 Gyr, from Zhou et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-251 (pscomppars): rotation period 3.84 d, from Zhou et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.881 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.991. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.
